text: Security is a vital part of web development. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt data between users and your server, protecting passwords and personal information. Second, strong authentication ensures that only real users can access accounts, often using passwords and extra checks like codes sent to phones. Third, input validation checks everything users type into forms, blocking harmful code before it reaches your system. Finally, be aware of common vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which attackers use to steal data or damage websites. By following these practices, developers can build safer, more trustworthy web applications for everyone.
